title.text: Listed gardens per 100,000 residents, by council area
title.subtitle: Gardens in the ACFCGN directory (2018) per 100,000 residents at 30 June 2025 (ABS). Zoom in to see the city councils

transform.filter: Zoom_selection == null || datum.properties.STE_NAME21 == Zoom_selection || (Zoom_selection == 'Sydney' && datum.properties.cx > 150.2 && datum.properties.cx < 151.5 && datum.properties.cy > -34.35 && datum.properties.cy < -33.15) || (Zoom_selection == 'Melbourne' && datum.properties.cx > 144.4 && datum.properties.cx < 145.7 && datum.properties.cy > -38.45 && datum.properties.cy < -37.4) || (Zoom_selection == 'Brisbane' && datum.properties.cx > 152.55 && datum.properties.cx < 153.5 && datum.properties.cy > -27.9 && datum.properties.cy < -26.9) || (Zoom_selection == 'Perth' && datum.properties.cx > 115.5 && datum.properties.cx < 116.4 && datum.properties.cy > -32.7 && datum.properties.cy < -31.4) || (Zoom_selection == 'Adelaide' && datum.properties.cx > 138.4 && datum.properties.cx < 138.95 && datum.properties.cy > -35.2 && datum.properties.cy < -34.5) || (Zoom_selection == 'Hobart' && datum.properties.cx > 147.0 && datum.properties.cx < 147.75 && datum.properties.cy > -43.2 && datum.properties.cy < -42.6)

transform.calculate: datum['Gardens per 100,000 residents'] == 0 ? 'None listed' : datum['Gardens per 100,000 residents'] < 2 ? 'Under 2' : datum['Gardens per 100,000 residents'] < 5 ? '2 to 5' : datum['Gardens per 100,000 residents'] < 10 ? '5 to 10' : '10 or more'
